```{r setup, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)   # masks lme4::lmer; same models, but summary() reports p-values (Aim Rmds use lmerTest::lmer too)
library(emmeans)
library(EnvStats)   # stat_n_text()

# Hmisc must be installed (not attached) for stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot")
```


# Read in data

| common column   | meaning |
|-----------------|---------|
| `sub_id`        | `response_uuid` |
| `age`           | 6 or 12 months (already snapped in the Aim Rmds); factor with 6 as reference |
| `measure`       | task outcome (see below) |
| `item`          | trial / word pair, used as a crossed random intercept (NA where the Aim models don't use one) |
| `stimulus_type` | VPC (Social / Non-social) and Numeracy (5- / 20-item stream) only |
| `block`         | Prediction only (Block 1 / Block 2) |


```{r}
main_dir <- here::here()

# same helper functions as the Aim 1 / Aim 2 Rmds (includes run_condition_model in models_func.R)
invisible(lapply(
  list.files(
    here::here("Main_Functions"),
    pattern = "\\.R$",
    full.names = TRUE), source))

tasks <- c("geosocial", "vpc", "audiovisual", "prediction",
           "word_comprehension", "numeracy", "helperhinderer")

# One row per task: file name + which column holds the outcome / random-effect item / stimulus type / block.
# NA = that task doesn't have that column. Column names are exactly what the Aim Rmds write.
task_spec <- tribble(
  ~task,                ~file,            ~measure_col,  ~item_col,     ~stim_col,       ~block_col,
  "geosocial",          "geosocial.csv",  "target_prop", "Trial",       NA_character_,   NA_character_,
  "vpc",                "vpc.csv",        "target_prop", "Trial Total", "Stimulus type", NA_character_,
  "audiovisual",        "av.csv",         "target_prop", "Trial",       NA_character_,   NA_character_,
  "prediction",         "prediction.csv", "aem_prop",    NA_character_, NA_character_,   "block",
  "word_comprehension", "word.csv",       "diff",        "Word_Pair",   NA_character_,   NA_character_,
  "numeracy",           "numeracy.csv",   "target_prop", "Trial",       "Stimulus type", NA_character_,
  "helperhinderer",     "hh.csv",         "target_prop", "Trial",       NA_character_,   NA_character_
)

read_task <- function(task, file, measure_col, item_col, stim_col, block_col) {
  # pull a column if the task has it, otherwise fill with NA
  grab <- function(raw, col) if (is.na(col)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(raw)) else as.character(raw[[col]])
  
  map_df(c(aim1 = "Aim1", aim2 = "Aim2"), .id = "version", function(aim) {
    raw <- read_csv(here::here(aim, "Data", "Computed_Data", file), show_col_types = FALSE)
    tibble(
      sub_id        = raw$response_uuid,
      age           = raw$Age,
      measure       = raw[[measure_col]],
      item          = grab(raw, item_col),
      stimulus_type = grab(raw, stim_col),
      block         = grab(raw, block_col)
    )
  }) |>
    mutate(task = task)
}

d_raw <- pmap_dfr(task_spec, read_task)
```

Outcomes:

* Geosocial: Outcome is % frames looking at social stimulus (`target_prop`).
* VPC: Outcome is % frames looking at novel stimulus (`target_prop`).
* AV: Outcome is % frames looking at synchronous stimulus (`target_prop`).
* Prediction: Outcome is proportion of trials with an AEM, per participant per block (`aem_prop`).
* Word Comprehension: Outcome is % target - % distracter (`diff`), per participant per word pair.
* Numeracy: Outcome is % frames looking at changing stimulus (`target_prop`).
* Helper/Hinderer: Outcome is % frames looking at helping stimulus (`target_prop`; trials 7 and 14 only).

Recode: Age 6 is the reference level; Numeracy stimulus type uses the same labels as the Aim Rmds
(Large Constant = 20-item stream, Small Constant = 5-item stream).

```{r}
d <- d_raw |>
  mutate(
    age     = factor(age, levels = c(6, 12)),
    version = factor(version, levels = c("aim1", "aim2"), labels = c("Study 1", "Study 2")),
    task    = factor(task, levels = tasks),
    stimulus_type = case_when(
      task == "numeracy" & grepl("Large", stimulus_type) ~ "20-item constant stream",
      task == "numeracy"                                 ~ "5-item constant stream",
      TRUE                                               ~ stimulus_type
    ),
    # Social first for plotting; numeracy 5-item first (reference level)
    stimulus_type = factor(stimulus_type,
                           levels = c("Social", "Non-social",
                                      "5-item constant stream", "20-item constant stream")),
    block = factor(block)
  )

# sanity checks: catch a bad merge/recode before it silently drops rows from the models
# stopifnot(!any(is.na(d$age)), !any(is.na(d$measure)))
# d |> count(task, version, age) |> pivot_wider(names_from = c(version, age), values_from = n)
# d |> distinct(task, stimulus_type, block)
# 
# # participant-level means (used for plotting only; models use the trial-level rows)
d_sub <- d |>
  group_by(version, sub_id, age, task, stimulus_type) |>
  summarise(measure = mean(measure, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(!is.nan(measure))
```

Plot.

```{r}
# One plotting function instead of seven copy-pasted blocks.
# cols = c(Study 1 colour, Study 2 colour); unit_scale = fix y to 0-1 (proportions); facet = split by stimulus type
plot_task <- function(task_name, ylab, cols, chance = 0.5, unit_scale = TRUE, facet = FALSE) {
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = .4)
  # Facet panels are narrow, so spread the text a bit wider than the points to stop labels touching
  dodge_txt <- position_dodge(width = if (facet) .65 else .4)
  dat   <- filter(d_sub, task == task_name)

  rng  <- if (unit_scale) 1 else diff(range(dat$measure))
  base <- if (unit_scale) 0.02 else min(dat$measure) - 0.10 * rng

  n_lab <- dat |>
    count(age, version, stimulus_type) |>
    mutate(y = base)

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = age, y = measure, col = version)) +
    geom_point(alpha = .4, position = dodge) +
    geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = age, y = y, group = version, label = paste0("n=", n)),
              position = dodge_txt, colour = "black",
              size = if (facet) 3.2 else 4, vjust = 0,
              inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = dodge, pch = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = chance, lty = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    ggthemes::theme_few() +
    labs(x = "Age", y = ylab, col = "Study")

  p <- if (unit_scale) {
    p + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, .25, .50, .75, 1), limits = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00"))
  } else {
    p + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.05)))
  }

  if (facet) p <- p + facet_wrap(~stimulus_type)
  p
}

# p1 ... p7 definitions unchanged

p1 <- plot_task("geosocial", "Proportion of looks fixating on\nsocial stimuli",
                c("palevioletred3", "palevioletred4"))
p2 <- plot_task("vpc", "Proportion of looks fixating on\nnovel images",
                c("lightpink3", "lightpink4"), facet = TRUE)
p3 <- plot_task("prediction", "Proportion of AEMs",
                c("lightsalmon3", "lightsalmon4"))
p4 <- plot_task("audiovisual", "Proportion of looks fixating on\nsynchronous stimuli",
                c("lightgoldenrod3", "lightgoldenrod4"))
p5 <- plot_task("word_comprehension", "Difference in proportions\n(target (%) - distracter (%))",
                c("darkolivegreen3", "darkolivegreen4"), chance = 0, unit_scale = FALSE)
p6 <- plot_task("numeracy", "Proportion of looks fixating on\nchanging stimuli",
                c("mediumpurple3", "mediumpurple4"), facet = TRUE)
p7 <- plot_task("helperhinderer", "Proportion of looks fixating on\nhelper stimuli",
                c("lightblue3", "lightblue4"))
```

```{r, fig.width= 15, fig.height=13}
figure_combined <- ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7,
                             ncol = 2, nrow = 4, labels = "auto", align = "hv")
figure_combined   # print once

save(figure_combined,
     file = file.path(main_dir, "Combined", "combined_figure.RData"))
```

# Stats

All model output uses `run_condition_model()` (`models_func.R`), the same helper as the Aim 1 and Aim 2 Rmds:
`lmerTest::lmer` with REML, emmeans estimates tested against chance, 95% CIs, `adjust = "none"`.


```{r}
# Model data: helper expects the age column to be named Age. `by` builds the Study x stimulus/block grouping factor.
model_d <- function(x, by = NULL) {
  out <- d |>
    filter(task == x) |>
    rename(Age = age) |>
    mutate(version = as.character(version))
  if (is.null(by)) out else mutate(out, group = paste(version, .data[[by]], sep = " | "))
}

re_item <- c("(1 | sub_id)", "(1 | item)")
re_sub  <- "(1 | sub_id)"

# Thin wrapper so each task below is one line; mirrors the run_condition_model() calls in the Aim Rmds.
run_comb <- function(task_name, label, chance, random_effects, by = NULL) {
  run_condition_model(
    data           = model_d(task_name, by),
    condition_var  = c("Age", if (is.null(by)) "version" else "group"),
    metric         = "measure",
    chance_level   = chance,
    caption_label  = label,
    random_effects = random_effects,
    interaction    = TRUE,
    return_data    = FALSE   # TRUE returns the raw data frame (Condition, Estimate (95% CI), P-value), as saved in the Aim Rmds
  )
}
```

## Geosocial

```{r}
tab_geo_comb <- run_comb("geosocial", "Geosocial (Age x Study)", 0.5, re_item)
tab_geo_comb
```

## VPC

```{r}
tab_vpc_comb <- run_comb("vpc", "VPC (Age x Study x Stimulus type)", 0.5, re_item, by = "stimulus_type")
tab_vpc_comb
```

## Audiovisual

No stimulus type in either study's AV data (the Aim models are age only).

```{r}
tab_av_comb <- run_comb("audiovisual", "Audiovisual (Age x Study)", 0.5, re_item)
tab_av_comb
```

## Prediction

Let's first look across blocks and then within. Rows are participant x block (`aem_prop`).

```{r}
tab_pred_comb <- run_comb("prediction", "Prediction, across blocks (Age x Study)", 0.5, re_sub)
tab_pred_comb
```

```{r}
tab_pred_block_comb <- run_comb("prediction", "Prediction (Age x Study x Block)", 0.5, re_sub, by = "block")
tab_pred_block_comb
```

## Word comprehension

`item` = word pair (as in the Aim models). Chance is 0 for the target - distracter difference.

```{r}
tab_word_comb <- run_comb("word_comprehension", "Word comprehension (Age x Study)", 0, re_item)
tab_word_comb
```

## Numeracy

Also a stimulus type interaction.

```{r}

tab_num_comb
```

```{r}
tab_num_stim_comb <- run_comb("numeracy", "Numeracy (Age x Study x Stimulus type)", 0.5, re_item, by = "stimulus_type")
tab_num_stim_comb
```
